data.name: CH9350DS.PDF
data.content: CH9350 datasheet. A controller chip that realizes USB keyboard/mouse to UART communication. The transmission distance is extended through UART. It is convenient for KVM products to manage and control USB keyboard and USB mouse remotely.

relationFileList.content: CH9340 datasheet, USB CDC to single serial port, built-in crystal oscillator, supports built-in CDC driver in operating system.
